g.text: DISPLAY STACK: ROUND TFT (TOP) DIRECTLY ABOVE RECT OLED (BOTTOM)

g.desc: DISPLAY STACK: ROUND TFT (TOP) DIRECTLY ABOVE RECT OLED (BOTTOM)

g.text: 4. Wire Crossings: Semicircular hop-over bridges indicate non-connected wire crossings; green junction dots indicate connected electrical nodes.

g.desc: 4. Wire Crossings: Semicircular hop-over bridges indicate non-connected wire crossings; green junction dots indicate connected electrical nodes.

g.text: pull-ups on B2/B3/DS2 yield R_eq ~ 1.6k-10k @ 100 kHz (add 4.7k only if open).

g.desc: pull-ups on B2/B3/DS2 yield R_eq ~ 1.6k-10k @ 100 kHz (add 4.7k only if open).

g.text: 3. Soil ADC & Regulator: B1 AOUT -> GPIO4 (ADC1_CH4, 0-2.5V @ 11dB; calibrate dry/wet). 2S 7.4V BMS Pack -> U2 (pre-check VO=3.30V) -> +3V3.

g.desc: 3. Soil ADC & Regulator: B1 AOUT -> GPIO4 (ADC1_CH4, 0-2.5V @ 11dB; calibrate dry/wet). 2S 7.4V BMS Pack -> U2 (pre-check VO=3.30V) -> +3V3.

g.text: 3. I2C Pull-Ups: Meter R(SDA->3V3) & R(SCL->3V3) unpowered to confirm onboard

g.desc: 3. I2C Pull-Ups: Meter R(SDA->3V3) & R(SCL->3V3) unpowered to confirm onboard

g.text: 2. Dedicated SPI Bus (GPIO5=SCK, GPIO3=MOSI, GPIO10=CS, GPIO1=DC, GPIO0=RST): Drives top round GC9A01 TFT (DS1, 3.3V only; never join to I2C).

g.desc: 2. Dedicated SPI Bus (GPIO5=SCK, GPIO3=MOSI, GPIO10=CS, GPIO1=DC, GPIO0=RST): Drives top round GC9A01 TFT (DS1, 3.3V only; never join to I2C).

g.text: is plugged into U1 so U1's onboard 3.3V LDO and U2 VO never fight on +3V3.

g.desc: is plugged into U1 so U1's onboard 3.3V LDO and U2 VO never fight on +3V3.

g.text: 2. Dual-Supply Isolation: Unplug the U2 VO breadboard jumper wire whenever USB-C 5V

g.desc: 2. Dual-Supply Isolation: Unplug the U2 VO breadboard jumper wire whenever USB-C 5V

g.text: 1. Shared I2C Bus (GPIO6=SDA, GPIO7=SCL @ 100 kHz): B2 (0x38+0x76/0x77), B3 (0x23, ADDR->GND), DS2 (0x3C); verify R(SDA/SCL->3V3) ~ 1.6k-10k.

g.desc: 1. Shared I2C Bus (GPIO6=SDA, GPIO7=SCL @ 100 kHz): B2 (0x38+0x76/0x77), B3 (0x23, ADDR->GND), DS2 (0x3C); verify R(SDA/SCL->3V3) ~ 1.6k-10k.

g.text: protection; meter U2 VO = 3.25-3.35V w/ DMM before connecting VO jumper.

g.desc: protection; meter U2 VO = 3.25-3.35V w/ DMM before connecting VO jumper.

g.text: 1. Battery & BMS: Confirm 2S Li-ion pack (7.4V, 6.0-8.4V) has physical 2S BMS

g.desc: 1. Battery & BMS: Confirm 2S Li-ion pack (7.4V, 6.0-8.4V) has physical 2S BMS

g.text: POWER SUPPLY & STEP-DOWN REGULATION STAGE (2S 7.4V BATTERY -> DD4012SA 3.3V BUCK)

g.desc: POWER SUPPLY & STEP-DOWN REGULATION STAGE (2S 7.4V BATTERY -> DD4012SA 3.3V BUCK)
